description.from: Codex owns the local migration: add GitBouncer command/module and README positioning while retaining Pudicus command/import compatibility, existing configuration filenames, secret path, hook runtime and receipt validators. Check distribution-name availability and release behavior before changing the PyPI distribution. Add offline tests; record local versus published state explicitly.
description.to: Local compatibility preparation is complete in a separate small review copy: GitBouncer alias package and CLI entry point, legacy Pudicus command/imports retained, distribution name still pudicus, and original configuration paths/secret path/receipt identifiers/rules preserved. Five compatibility tests pass, including offline wheel inspection using existing build tools. Actual hook runtime passed three runtime tests; packaging checks ran in the existing packaging environment. No dependency installation, metadata refresh, package publication or rename-source push occurred. External branding is paused for https://github.com/achrafash/gitbouncer overlap resolution; keep local work reviewable and preserve the working Pudicus integration. New bare launcher requires a reviewed metadata refresh after the decision.
